raster_qa.source_metadata: TIFFTAG_ARTIST=Solargis; TIFFTAG_COPYRIGHT=© 2020 The World Bank; TIFFTAG_IMAGEDESCRIPTION links global PV study
raster_qa.note: Approx 30 arcsecond source resolution, not a true uniform 1km projected raster. Raster nodata is nan except LCOE float32 max sentinel. No complete-cell numeric read of global rasters.

south_india_sanity_window.WARNING: RECTANGULAR ENVELOPE ONLY; contains Kerala and non-Kerala cells including sea/neighbour states; cannot be reported as Kerala statistics; no authoritative polygon clip done.

interpretation.PVOUT_level0: unmasked modeled practical specific yield, long-term average, kWh/kWp/day (base study)
interpretation.PVOUT_level1: PVOUT after global-study physical/technical screening; not a legal Kerala siting ruling
interpretation.PVOUT_level2: PVOUT after study physical/technical and soft/regulatory proxies; NOT legally authoritative protected area map
interpretation.seasonality: ratio of highest to lowest monthly average PVOUT; dimensionless
interpretation.LCOE: simplified study-specific lifetime metric; study text gives USD/kWh and globally simplified CAPEX/OPEX/WACC/degradation inputs; not Kerala 2026 or 2040 cost
interpretation.model_use: reference and cross-check only pending Kerala NWIC polygon clip, data interpretation/units verification against study, technology selection and scenario calibration
interpretation.monthly_and_hourly_limitation: annual long-term raster and index, not 2024-25 hourly weather or PV generation
